sentences.span: The identified mispriced risk is contagion: the order is explicitly positioned by its sponsors as a national model, with Virginia and Texas identified as the markets where adoption ... would have the most material impact

sentences.span: Japanese Yen. Support has broken the 155 level solidly (closing at 156.9)
sentences.why: The 155-break/156.9-close figures are Academy Securities'. But the '-2.08% last week' and 'biggest weekly decline since October 2025' figures belong to Deutsche Bank's Early Morning Reid ('the Japanese Yen weakened -2.08% against the US Dollar last week, which marked its biggest weekly decline since October 2025') — a different bank's statistic that Academy's own note never states, folded under a single 'per Academy Securities' attribution. Who-said-it error on part of the sentence.

sentences.span: Trade idea: Maintain long USD/JPY at 156.23 with a target of 163.00 and a stop of 150.00
sentences.why: MS's 150.00 is a stop-loss on a long-USD/JPY (weak-yen) trade — the level at which that trade is invalidated/closed for a loss, not where the argument 'wins.' The sentence inverts the direction of what the level means.
